description: Register every currently-live provider leaf so the hub federates what exists today, including agent-manager.runs for attributable prior-work recall. Each is a declarative descriptor plus ResultMapping and remains owned by its source scenario.

requirements.title: All live leaves registered
requirements.description: Live leaves, including agent-manager.runs, are registered with valid descriptors and ResultMappings. Agent conversation hits retain chunk identity for deduplication while mapped run_id metadata supports durable run-level evaluation and context recovery.

validation.notes: ListProviders returns all live leaves with ACTIVE state and valid mappings, including agent-manager.runs.
A prior-conversation query selects agent-manager.runs and preserves run/event provenance through federation.
